column1: # v37 consolidated company ASN legal-evidence ledger — 2026-11-10
# 41 unique ASNs: 36 legacy rows from PR #2 plus 5 v37 additions.
# v37 counts/country are joined from the release-branch geoip_RU_BY_KZ_asn_manifest.txt.
# No manifest row means no prefix observed in that specific ipverse snapshot (counts 0); it does not mean the ASN registration is deleted.
# 16 rows reviewed or newly verified in this stage; 25 legacy rows explicitly remain pending revalidation.
# ASN-level registration and BGP origin do not establish ownership/control of every originated prefix.

column14: ASSESSMENT_NOTE
RIPE ASN registration identifies VimpelCom; this does not establish resource-holder status for every originated prefix.
ASN-level organization matches MTS; the origin prefix set may include customer or leased resources.

RIPE aut-num AS8402 retains as-name CORBINA-AS and legacy descr OJSC "Vimpelcom", but its org field is ORG-CTaM1-RIPE, whose current RIPE organisation object names PJSC "Vimpelcom" (RU; reg. no. 1027700166636; last-modified 2026-05-13). Therefore the ASN-level registrant matches the current PJSC VimpelCom entity used by the allowlist; CORBINA is the network/legacy identity and OJSC is an older description, not a different legal registrant. This does not establish that every AS8402-originated prefix is held by VimpelCom.
RIPE organization matches the listed legal entity. ASN registration does not prove that every customer or downstream route is ER-Telecom-owned.

Current RIPE AS9123 (TimeWeb-AS; ORG-TL188-RIPE) identifies JSC TIMEWEB, RU, reg. no. 1247800127112 (current RIPE organisation update reflected by WBDT). Routing policy explicitly separates uplinks, IX/peers and downlinks; it lists multiple downstream hosting/customer ASNs and product classes including virtual hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and IP transit. ipctl's 2026-11-09 observation shows about 1,000 of 1,002 announced prefixes visible. v37 manifest counts are 357 IPv4 and 11 IPv6. This verifies the operator identity, not ownership of each customer/tenant-origin prefix.
RIPE ASN organization matches PJSC Rostelecom. The large operator network can originate customer, subsidiary and managed-service resources as well as its own.
RIPE organization ORG-OM1-RIPE identifies PJSC MegaFon.
RIPE org ORG-YA1-RIPE identifies YANDEX LLC. Prefix ownership/control remains a separate per-prefix question.

RIPE registers AS15774 (TTK-RTL; ORG-LLC51-RIPE) to Limited Liability Company TTK-Svyaz, RU, reg. no. 1037739164451, not to JSC TransTeleCom. The ASN transfer history records a transfer from JSC TransTeleCom to LLC TTK-Svyaz on 2021-06-24. TransTeleCom's official group page identifies JSC Company TransTeleCom as the group's head company and LLC TTK-Svyaz as a group company. This confirms a group relationship but not identity of the two legal entities. ASN registration does not prove resource ownership for every originated prefix.
RIPE responsible organization is Joint Stock Company TransTeleCom; this directly supports the ASN-level legal-entity label.
RIPE organization name matches MGTS/PJSC Moscow City Telephone Network.
RIPE organization is LLC VK; this ASN is described as a regional CDN network. CDN origin routes can include customer/partner resources.

RIPE registers AS31133 (MF-MGSM-AS) to ORG-OM1-RIPE / PJSC MegaFon; PeeringDB independently identifies AS31133 as MegaFon and lists it among ASNs managed by MegaFon. A secondary system-operator directory at mi.org.ru lists AS31133 under Rostelecom, but this attribution is not corroborated by the current RIPE organisation object or PeeringDB network record. Keep PJSC MegaFon as the ASN-level identity and retain the stale/discordant directory entry as a source-quality note, not as an unresolved registry conflict. This is ASN attribution only, not ownership proof for each origin prefix.

RIPE registers AS34879 (CCT-AS) to OOO "Sovremennye setevye tekhnologii" (ORG-CCT1-RIPE), RU, reg. no. 1057747348427. NGENIX is the operating/CDN brand, not the registered legal entity; RIPE role and official NGENIX documentation use the OOO SST legal name and NGENIX service identity. Current RIPE-derived route views include prefixes registered to OOO SST and some legacy NGENIX-* IRR route labels; ROA/IRR route authorisation does not by itself prove resource ownership. Normalize the company label to the legal entity and retain NGENIX as brand.
RIPE org ORG-SORP1-RIPE identifies Sberbank of Russia PJSC.

column3: PJSC Rostelecom (NCNET-AS; legacy Moscow access-network identity)
column14: The RIPE aut-num has as-name NCNET-AS and legacy descr 'OJSC National Cable Networks', but its org field points to ORG-JR8-RIPE, whose current RIPE organisation name is PJSC Rostelecom (reg. no. 1027700198767). Therefore the ASN-level registered organisation matches PJSC Rostelecom; the old table incorrectly treated the descr/as-name as the legal registrant. NCNET remains the operational/network identity. This is ASN-level evidence only and does not prove that every originated prefix is owned by Rostelecom.
RIPE and Russian registries identify LLC Internet Solutions; Ozon is the associated operating brand. Check resource-holder status on each prefix separately.
RIPE aut-num references ORG-YA1-RIPE (YANDEX LLC). The ASN is active in the v37 manifest. Registration identity supports the ASN-level company label, not ownership of every originated prefix.
RIPE org ORG-VL47-RIPE identifies LLC VK; this ASN is described as a main VK network.
RIPE org ORG-VL47-RIPE identifies LLC VK; ASN name/description says Moscow CDN. Keep legal entity as LLC VK and CDN role as a separate note.
RIPE org ORG-VL47-RIPE identifies LLC VK even though the ASN retains a Mail.Ru-era name; the legacy brand is not the current registered legal entity.

RIPE org ORG-RA21-RIPE is JSC ER-Telecom Holding, while the ASN's as-name is Milecom-as and the maintainer is associated with Milecom. Legal organization matches the allowlist, but retain the ASN-name/maintainer discrepancy for audit.

RIPE registers AS49053 (AS_WB-TECH) to LLC Wildberries (ORG-LW30-RIPE), RU, reg. no. 1067746062449. The v37 ipverse-derived manifest contains no AS49053 routes (0 IPv4/IPv6), but WBDT's current observation dated 2026-11-10 reports exactly one directly originated prefix, 185.62.203.0/24 (256 IPv4), origin AS49053, no MOAS, one valid ROA and one exact IRR route. RIPE aut-num explicitly accepts routes from AS57073 and exports AS49053 to it; AS57073 is an upstream/peer relationship, not the origin of this prefix. Treat the discrepancy as an input observation-window/source difference, not ASN inactivity or evidence to delete the company ASN. This audit does not change DIRECT output.
RIPE org ORG-SL223-RIPE identifies JSC Selectel. Selectel is a hosting/cloud provider; each customer or leased prefix still requires a separate ownership/control decision.
RIPE org ORG-SL223-RIPE identifies JSC Selectel; AS50340 is the Moscow Selectel network. Customer/tenant route ownership remains unverified.
RIPE organization identifies LLC Wildberries. External route data shows AS57073 can carry downstream/customer networks (including AS49053); not every propagated route is Wildberries-owned.

RIPE registers AS57724 (DDOS-GUARD; ORG-DL236-RIPE) to DDOS-GUARD LTD, RU, reg. no. 1149204010988; organisation details were updated 2026-09-11. Current BGP views show a materially larger announced set than the originated set (bgp.he reports 35 originated versus 491 announced), consistent with a mitigation/transit network carrying external customer routes. v37 manifest counts are 20 IPv4 and 1 IPv6 selected origin prefixes. The ASN identity is confirmed, but neither the announced set nor all originated prefixes should be treated as DDOS-GUARD-owned without prefix-level holder/authorisation evidence.
RIPE organization identifies Yandex.Cloud LLC. Cloud ASN origins can include customer/tenant prefixes; do not equate ASN identity with ownership of every origin prefix.
RIPE org ORG-LW30-RIPE identifies LLC Wildberries; external registry classifies the ASN as Wildberries CDN. Verify CDN/partner prefix resource holders individually.

RIPE registers AS202611 (YCTL; ORG-YCTL2-RIPE) to Yandex.Telecom LLC, RU. Current BGP prefix details show 2 IPv4 and 1 IPv6 routes, matching the v37 manifest: 91.107.80.0/22 is described/registered as Yandex.Cloud LLC, while 185.32.184.0/23 and 2a0b:1440::/32 are described as Yandex.Telecom LLC. This confirms the ASN carries at least one route attributed to another Yandex group legal entity; it does not collapse Yandex.Telecom LLC and Yandex.Cloud LLC into one legal person or prove ownership of every origin prefix.

RIPE identifies ORG-YL30-RIPE as Yandex.OFD LLC, a separate legal entity from YANDEX LLC. RIPE aut-num remarks identify YANDEX as a peer and ORG-YA1-RIPE as sponsoring organisation; neither fact collapses the two legal entities into one. Current sources show one IPv4 and one IPv6 origin prefix; prefix registrant attribution must be checked separately.

column3: Y. Izdeu men Jarnama LLP (Yandex Kazakhstan operating legal entity)
column14: RIPE registers AS207304 (Y-KZ; ORG-YIJL1-RIPE) to Y. Izdeu men Jarnama LLP, KZ, reg. no. 170240015454; current Yandex Kazakhstan legal terms independently name this LLP as the local Yandex contracting entity. v37 manifest has one IPv4 and one IPv6 origin. The IPv6 route 2a14:48c5::/48 is attributed to Y. Izdeu men Jarnama LLP. For 45.138.0.0/24, the parent allocation 45.138.0.0/22 is registered to Direct Cursus Technology LLC, but RIPE's more-specific assignment/contact data for Yandex Kazakhstan addresses within the /24 names Y. Izdeu men Jarnama LLP (ORG-YIJL1-RIPE), while the route object is originated by AS207304 and maintained by Direct Cursus. Some ASN/prefix lookup databases label the full /24 by the parent allocation holder, others by Y. Izdeu. Treat this as parent-allocation/sub-assignment metadata disagreement; do not infer Direct Cursus is the corporate owner of the Yandex Kazakhstan ASN or the entire /24.

column5: Cloud Technologies LLC trading as Cloud.ru
column14: RIPE registers AS208677 to "Cloud Technologies" LLC trading as Cloud.ru (ORG-CTL61-RIPE), RU, reg. no. 5167746080057. Current WBDT data describes the ASN as a hosting/transit network with 103 address ranges and identifies downstream networks including OKKO LLC and JSC Settlement Solutions; the RIPE aut-num also lists several large upstreams/peers. v37 manifest counts are 96 IPv4 and 1 IPv6 origin prefixes. The company legal identity is a direct match, but its hosting/transit role makes it unsafe to infer that all customer, tenant or downstream-related prefixes are Cloud.ru resources.

column3: Cloud Services Kazakhstan LLP (Yandex Cloud Kazakhstan public-connectivity legal entity)
column14: RIPE registers AS208795 (YANDEXCLOUDKZ; ORG-YKL1-RIPE) to Cloud Services Kazakhstan LLP, KZ, reg. no. 210140006471. The official Yandex Cloud Kazakhstan documentation footer names ТОО «Облачные Сервисы Казахстан»; its public-connection documentation describes the Yandex Cloud service endpoints. The RIPE aut-num lists Yandex Cloud (AS200350) as a peer and the Kazakh carriers as uplinks, which supports the network's Yandex Cloud public-connectivity role but does not make this LLP the same legal entity as Yandex.Cloud LLC. v37 manifest counts are 6 IPv4 and 1 IPv6. Current route/IRR views include both Cloud Services Kazakhstan LLP-labelled routes and routes labelled Yandex.Cloud LLC; preserve per-prefix holder review instead of assigning all origins to a single group entity.

RIPE identifies ORG-YL62-RIPE as Yandex.Cloud LLC. The aut-num has an explicit Yandex Cloud relationship to AS200350. Cloud ASN registration does not establish that every originated route is owned by Yandex.Cloud LLC.

RIPE registers AS210756 to EdgeCenter LLC (ORG-GRL12-RIPE), RU, reg. no. 1137746982966. Current BGP views show a substantial hosting/CDN network (bgp.he reports 122 IPv4 and 23 IPv6 originated prefixes); a RIPEstat-derived observation lists multiple upstream and downstream neighbours, including eight downstream neighbours. v37 manifest counts are 73 IPv4 and 11 IPv6 prefixes. This confirms the ASN-level company identity and a multi-tenant/transit topology, but does not prove that every originated or carried prefix is owned by EdgeCenter LLC.

column3: LLC Wildberries (AS_WILDBERRIES_GE; RU-registered ASN with Georgian upstreams)
column14: RIPE registers AS211517 (AS_WILDBERRIES_GE; ORG-LW30-RIPE) to LLC Wildberries, RU, reg. no. 1067746062449. Current v37 snapshot contains 1 IPv4 and 2 IPv6 prefixes. The ASN's upstreams AS57814 and AS34797 are Georgian, and some prefix objects carry GE-WILDBERRIES/country=GE metadata; neither fact changes the ASN organisation's RU registration. For 90.156.245.0/24, RIPE shows GE-WILDBERRIES and Wildberries maintainership/contact data, not a named corporate org-holder. For 2a03:720:70::/48, BGP registry display labels the prefix registrant as Yaroslav Averyanov while the route is originated by AS211517 and maintained by Wildberries; this is not sufficient to assert individual ownership. 2a03:720:1070::/48 is labelled LLC Wildberries. Keep prefix-level holder/control as a separate review.

column3: Buyuk Reklam Cozumleri LLC (Yandex Türkiye operating legal entity; separate TR entity)
column14: RIPE registers AS212066 (Y-COM-TR; ORG-YATR1-RIPE) to Buyuk Reklam Cozumleri LLC, TR, trade registry no. 477257-5. Yandex Türkiye's official contacts and User Agreement identify Büyük Reklam Çözümleri Ltd. Şti. as the local legal entity providing Yandex services. RIPE sponsoring-org ORG-DCTL3-RIPE denotes the sponsoring LIR, not proof of corporate parentage. Current v37 snapshot has 2 IPv4 and 2 IPv6 prefixes. BGP collectors observe MOAS for 5.45.215.0/24 and 2a02:6b8:215::/48 with AS13238, AS208398 and AS212066; the registry/route data attributes those resources to YANDEX LLC, so origin by AS212066 is not ownership proof. 45.148.65.0/24 is announced by AS212066 but its parent/subrange data is split between Buyuk Reklam and Direct Cursus Technology LLC. 2a14:48c6::/48 is attributed to Buyuk Reklam. Preserve per-prefix review and do not equate the Turkish operating entity with YANDEX LLC.

RIPE identifies ORG-YCTL2-RIPE as Yandex.Telecom LLC. The ASN is registered and has Yandex Cloud operational/peering context, but the checked route source reports zero IPv4 and IPv6 routes. Retain the ASN identity separately from its inactive/unannounced route state.
RIPE identifies Yandex.Cloud LLC and AS name YCCDN; BGP record shows peer/parent relationship to AS200350. CDN prefix ownership still requires prefix-level evidence.

column3: YANDEX LLC (not visible in global BGP since 2025-11-13)
column14: RIPE identifies ORG-YA1-RIPE as YANDEX LLC. The ASN is not currently visible in the global routing table; bgp.tools reports it has not been visible since 2025-11-13. The v37 manifest correctly records zero current IPv4/IPv6 prefixes. Do not infer that the ASN registration itself was deleted.
